branches.delta: CTK convergence asks for parse->canonicalize->semantic hash->typed IR->checker->lowering->runtime receipt->replay. Current run refines this to joined ancestry plus independent semantic validation.
C9 typed causal admission remains compatible; current run supports semantic identity != execution/contract identity but does not independently validate all authority assumptions.
TurnTraceEnvelope runtime validator is complementary to compiler provenance chain. Do not collapse compiler/build ancestry receipts into runtime causal trace receipts.
Stable parsed Ref identity and provenance/selection lineage depend on deterministic frontend identity; graph activation remains non-authoritative.
Typed semantic identity remains distinct from concrete representation/provenance identity. Compiler receipts should expose both.
Future lowering receipts must preserve addressability/delivery/reconstruction/uptake/use/outcome/re-entry identities; no new GWT syntax follows from this run.
No new topology primitive. Stable canonical semantics are prerequisite for meaningful topology/trace comparison.
Compiler receipt integrity is instrumentation/provenance, not emergence or consciousness evidence.
Frontend closure remains blocker. Linked stage hashes are audit evidence but cannot substitute for translation/semantic validation.

cross_branch_contradictions.statement: A fully self-consistent provenance chain can attest a semantically wrong compiler result.
cross_branch_contradictions.resolution: Keep provenance integrity and semantic preservation as orthogonal gates.

evidence_boundary: Repo-native/shared-ancestry material is not counted as independent replication. Local synthetic execution is not target Ubuntu evidence.
